sources.core_claim: BTC Donchian-channel-ensemble trend strategy + volatility-based sizing: Sharpe ratio above 1.5, annualized alpha 10.8% vs Bitcoin, net of fees.
sources.credibility: author-affiliated secondary page for SSRN 5209907 (full text 403-blocked); cross-checked in a prior round against two further author-affiliated mirrors (Substack, personal academic page) which agreed
sources.project_applicability: Primary basis for BTC_DONCHIAN_ENSEMBLE and CRYPTO_DONCHIAN_TOP3; exact lookback windows not recoverable, so implementation is a labeled approximation.
sources.reflection: Single-author-family source; no independent replication of the exact numbers found. Cost/fee assumption in the paper is unconfirmed vs this project's frozen 10bp/20bp contract -- reported as a methodology difference, not reconciled.

sources.core_claim: Liu-Tsyvinski-Wu cross-sectional crypto momentum: weekly VW long-short quintile returns 2.5-4.1% over 1-4 week horizons, sample 2014-2018.

sources.core_claim: Bitwise BTOP (10/20-day BTC EMA trend rotation, BTC/ETH CME futures vs T-bills), launched 2023-09-29, liquidated 2026-05-29 despite a reported positive since-inception return.
